description: Figure 5b, labeled “P6: Matching statistics,” is a pie chart that visually represents the distribution of preference matching frequency tiers for Persona 6 (P6) across seven personas (P1–P7). The chart is divided into six distinct slices, each corresponding to a frequency tier, with the size of each slice proportional to the number of questions matching within that tier. The largest slice, colored light blue, represents tier 5 with 27.2% (8,006 questions). The second largest, light gray, corresponds to tier 1 with 13.3% (3,910 questions). Tier 2, shown in light green, accounts for 22.4% (6,583 questions). Tier 3, in a muted teal, represents 6.8% (2,002 questions). Tier 4, in a darker teal, accounts for 6.2% (1,810 questions). The smallest slice, in a very light gray, represents tier 0 with 13.8% (4,046 questions). Each slice is labeled with its percentage and absolute count in parentheses. The chart includes a legend indicating the frequency tiers (0 through 5) and their corresponding colors, though the legend is not explicitly shown within the pie chart itself. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, starting from the top, with the largest slice (tier 5) positioned at the top right.
